Function to add to the template: "replace" — {"action":"replace","word":12,"text":"anno"}: the chip keeps its timing but its text becomes another real word
Example / what it catches: Audio says "hanno", chip says "anno". Catches annotators who only fix timings and never check the text against the audio.

Function to add to the template: "replace" with a homophone list per language (it: hanno/anno, ho/o, ha/a, l'una/luna, tè/te)
Example / what it catches: Audio "ho comprato", chip "o comprato". Same sound, different word: only context tells them apart (guideline 4.6).

Function to add to the template: "replace" with a one-letter change: {"action":"replace","word":5,"text":"bolonia"}
Example / what it catches: Audio "bologna", chip "bolonia" (like "likaku" -> "likake"). Catches annotators who skim near-identical words.

Function to add to the template: "replace" restricted to names, places and brands
Example / what it catches: Audio "valentino", chip "valentina". Names are easy to accept without checking.

Function to add to the template: "replace" that adds, removes or changes an accent: {"action":"replace","word":3,"text":"e"}
Example / what it catches: Audio "è" (is), chip "e" (and). In Italian the accent changes the meaning (e/è, la/là, perché).

Error category: Number written in the wrong form
Function to add to the template: "replace" number word -> digits or a wrong number form
Example / what it catches: Audio "venti", chip "20". Guideline: numbers always as words.

Function to add to the template: "replace" that respells a foreign word (Hindi: script_swap Latin <-> Devanagari)
Example / what it catches: Audio "weekend", chip "uichend". Guideline: English words keep their English spelling.

Function to add to the template: "delete" — {"action":"delete","word":40}: removes the chip AND the word from the transcript (today's "remove" keeps the text)
Example / what it catches: Audio says "domani", the transcript and the chips have no "domani". The annotator must hear it, type it and add a chip.

Function to add to the template: "delete" limited to fillers and backchannels (it: ehm, beh, cioè, mah, boh, mm hm, dai)
Example / what it catches: Audio "ehm allora", chips only "allora". Guideline 4.5: fillers are words and get their own chip.

Error category: Filler hidden inside the next word's chip
Function to add to the template: "absorb" — {"action":"absorb","word":6}: the filler's chip is removed and the next word's chip is stretched over it
Example / what it catches: Chip "allora" also covers the "ehm" before it. Guideline 2.3: a filler inside another word's segment must be split out.

Error category: One word split over two chips
Function to add to the template: "split" — {"action":"split","word":9,"at":4}: one word becomes two chips (text cut at a character, time cut in proportion)
Example / what it catches: Audio "pomeriggio", chips "pome" + "riggio". Guideline 2.3: one word spread over several segments must be merged.

Function to add to the template: "split" at the apostrophe of an elided form
Example / what it catches: Audio "dell'acqua", chips "dell'" + "acqua". Italian rule: elided forms are one segment.

Function to add to the template: "join" over 3 or more chips — {"action":"join","word":7,"count":3} (today's "join" takes exactly two)
Example / what it catches: Audio "r a i" spelled out, chip "rai". Guideline 4.4: letters said one by one get one segment each.

Error category: Truncation introduced (complete word marked as cut off)
Function to add to the template: "replace" that adds the cut-off hyphen: {"action":"replace","word":11,"text":"doma-"}
Example / what it catches: Audio "domani" fully spoken, chip "doma-". Guideline 4.3: only a word that is really cut off gets a hyphen.

Error category: Truncation completed (cut-off word written in full)
Function to add to the template: "replace" that removes the hyphen and completes the word
Example / what it catches: Speaker stops at "doma-", chip says "domani". Guideline 4.3: write only what is heard.

Function to add to the template: "zero" — {"action":"zero","word":15}: start = end
Example / what it catches: Chip "bene" from 4.20 to 4.20 s. Guideline 2.2: a zero-length segment is an error and must get the word's real length.

Function to add to the template: "overlap" — {"action":"overlap","word":20,"edge":"end","shift_ms":150}: moves an edge into the neighbour without the neighbour giving way
Example / what it catches: Chip "molto" ends 150 ms inside "bene". Guideline 2.2: segments from the same speaker must never overlap.

Function to add to the template: "move" accepting 40-149 ms, with a per-plant tolerance so small shifts can be scored (today: 150-700 ms only)
Example / what it catches: Chip "sera" starts 60 ms late. Catches annotators who accept edges that are nearly right (minor = 40-80 ms).

Error category: Chip over a cough, laugh or breath
Function to add to the template: "add_noise" — {"action":"add_noise","start":3.1,"end":3.4,"text":"ah"}: a chip placed on a non-speech sound, not only in a silent pause
Example / what it catches: Chip "ah" over a breath. Guideline 2.3: a segment covering only a cough, laugh or breath must be deleted.

Error category: Invented text for an unintelligible part
Function to add to the template: "replace_unin" — replaces a (()) chip with plausible words
Example / what it catches: Audio is unclear, chip says "alla fine" instead of (()). Catches over-confident annotators who accept guesses.

Function to add to the template: "replace" that strips the double brackets: ((pensato)) -> pensato
Example / what it catches: Chip "pensato" for a word that is only a guess. Guideline 2.5: a guess goes in double brackets.

Function to add to the template: "set_flag" — {"action":"set_flag","field":"multi_speaker","value":false}: file-level answer
Example / what it catches: Two people speak, the pre-fill says one speaker. The annotator must switch Multi-speaker on (Hindi: multiple_speakers_off).

Function to add to the template: "set_flag" for "overlap_speech"
Example / what it catches: Two speakers talk at once, the pre-fill says no overlap. Guideline 2.4.

Function to add to the template: "set_flag" for "audio_synthetic"
Example / what it catches: A text-to-speech file served as normal. The annotator must mark it via the dustbin button (guideline 2.5).

Function to add to the template: "set_speaker" — {"action":"set_speaker","word":30,"speaker":2}
Example / what it catches: In a two-speaker file, a word of speaker 1 is given to speaker 2. Guideline 2.4: each segment belongs to its own speaker.
